additional_primary_consultation.finding: The attached definitions distinguish auxiliary verb and adjective 하다. Verb affirmation includes 기는/기도/기나, broader than the pinned verb entry's narrow 기도 note; causal definitions distinguish verbs from adjective/copula uses. The attachment also separately admits a lexical subset of verbs before 어 하다. These findings are retained for further left-class/sense review, without new omission-based filters or contextual judgments.
